invariants.description: ribosome balance: n_ribo(t) - n_ribo(0) = int (R_ribo_build - R_ribo_loss) dt (relative 1e-6); never negative, never above the resting count when started at or below it
invariants.expr: abs(n_ribo[-1] - n_ribo[0] - np.trapz(R_ribo_build - R_ribo_loss, t)) <= 1e-6*np.trapz(np.abs(R_ribo_build) + np.abs(R_ribo_loss), t) + 1e-9 and np.all(n_ribo >= 0) and (n_ribo[0] > n_ribo_rest or np.all(n_ribo <= n_ribo_rest*(1 + 1e-12)))

invariants.description: loss, rebuilding and their costs (exact): u_upkeep = 1 - x_unpaid; R_ribo_loss = k_ribo n_ribo x_unpaid; R_ribo_build = k_ribo_build max(0, n_ribo_rest - n_ribo) u_upkeep^n_ribo_build; c_ribo_build = L_rRNA c_nt_denovo + aa_ribo c_aa_build; J_ribo = n_ribo L_rRNA c_nt_recycle k_ribo u_upkeep / N_A; J_ribo_build = R_ribo_build c_ribo_build / N_A; x_ribo = n_ribo / n_ribo_rest
invariants.expr: np.allclose(u_upkeep, 1 - x_unpaid, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(R_ribo_loss, k_ribo*n_ribo*x_unpaid, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(R_ribo_build, k_ribo_build*np.clip(n_ribo_rest - n_ribo, 0, None)*u_upkeep**n_ribo_build, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-12*k_ribo_build*n_ribo_rest) and np.allclose(c_ribo_build, L_rRNA*c_nt_denovo + aa_ribo*c_aa_build, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_ribo, n_ribo*L_rRNA*c_nt_recycle*k_ribo*u_upkeep/N_A, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(J_ribo_build, R_ribo_build*c_ribo_build/N_A, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(J_ATP_ribo, J_ribo + J_ribo_build, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(x_ribo, n_ribo/n_ribo_rest, rtol=1e-12, atol=0)

invariants.description: with the upkeep paid and the resting count nothing moves: no loss, no rebuilding, J_ATP_ribo is the resting rRNA upkeep (exact)
invariants.expr: np.any(x_unpaid != 0.0) or n_ribo[0] != n_ribo_rest or (np.all(R_ribo_loss == 0.0) and np.all(R_ribo_build == 0.0) and np.all(x_ribo == 1.0) and np.allclose(J_ATP_ribo, n_ribo_rest*L_rRNA*c_nt_recycle*k_ribo/N_A, rtol=1e-12, atol=0))

bc_sweep.rationale: the upkeep from unpaid to fully paid
